What is the error when Rohan uses a Monte Carlo-esque integration, putting 16 equally-spaced points throughout the region defined by 0 is less than or equal to x and y is less than or equal to 2 to approximate the area bounded by (x – 1)^2 + (y – 1)^2 = 1?

set.c.W: E-but-2-ene better resembles the transition state structure and is more reactive
set.c.X: E-but-2-ene better resembles the transition state structure and is less reactive
set.c.Y: Z-but-2-ene better resembles the transition state structure and is more reactive
set.c.Z: Z-but-2-ene better resembles the transition state structure and is less reactive

Shown in the image is the phase diagram of carbon steel. Answer the following three questions about this diagram: 1) Which lettered point is the eutectic point of steel? 2) Which lettered point is an example of an eutectoid point? 3) Below its stable temperature, austenite can separate into a two-phase lamellar structure composed of ferrite and Fe3C. What is the name of this structure?

Rayyan Ibrahim is on his way to Seaside Bakery to pick up ABGs when he realizes he has made a wrong turn and is now surrounded by AGB stars. Pictured below is a spectrum of an AGB star. Answer the following two questions regarding the spectra shown: 1) Identify the element responsible for the molecular band located at 695nm in the spectrum that first came into significant concentrations after the third dredge up 2) The broad drop in flux from 380 to 520 nm is due to the cumulative absorption of many molecules introduced during the third dredge up. Which of the following statements best describes the effect of this spectral feature on the star's observed B-V? W) B-V decreases because B-band flux is suppressed X) B-V increases because B-band flux is suppressed Y) B-V remains unchanged because both B and V fluxes are equally affected Z) B-V becomes negative because the V-band flux dominates the spectrum
set.a.t: 1) Carbon; 2) X) B-V increases because B-band flux is suppressed

Answer the following two questions about the imaged gel: 1) Which well contains the inhibitor that acts through an uncompetitive mechanism? 2) If apparent Vmax was measured for the enzyme under the influence of the inhibitor in well 2, would it be lower, the same, or higher than the Vmax of the enzyme under no inhibition?

Shown in the image is the top-down and side views of a DC motor, the side view being from the vantage point of a DC power source. There is a wire fixture connected to the pictured DC power source. The magnetic field within the region between the positive and negative magnets is 0.4 tesla, the wire fixture has a resistance of 2 ohms, and the DC power source supplies an electromotive force of 10 volts. Given that the legs of the wire fixture have length 10 centimeters, and the width of the wire fixture is 6 centimeters, answer the following questions about this DC motor: 1) In what direction does the motor rotate in the side view? 2) In newtons, what is the magnitude of the force applied to the left leg of the wire fixture? 3) In newton-meters, what is the torque supplied by this motor?

The Tower of Hanoi is a game in which you move a stack of n disks that start from largest at the bottom and go to smallest at the top from one peg to another such that at any move, you can only move one disk at a time, and any disk smaller than another must be atop that other disk. Pictured in the image is a setup of this game with 4 pegs, and a solution of 3 pegs and 2 disks. What is the minimum required moves to move a stack of 5 disks from one peg to another on: 1) A setup with 3 pegs. 2) A setup with 4 pegs

Shown in the image are four IR spectrums labelled A, B, C, and D. Answer the following three questions using these spectrums: 1) Which IR spectrum is for the compound benzonitrile? 2) Benzonitrile is treated with lithium aluminum hydride followed by aqueous workup. Which IR spectrum matches the product of this reaction? 3) In another reaction, benzonitrile is instead treated with hydronium ions in heat. Which IR spectrum matches the product of this reaction?

Pictured is a glacial landform produced beneath continental ice sheets. Answer the following two questions concerning this feature: 1) Identify the type of moraine shown in the image. 2) Which of the following best explains the formation of this landform? W) Deposition of till at the terminus during repeated stillstands of a retreating glacier X) Subglacial deformation and compression of water-saturated till beneath slow-moving ice Y) Meltwater deposition along braided streams from a retreating glacier Z) Supraglacial debris accumulation along shear zones within valley glaciers
set.a.t: 1) Rogen; 2) X) Subglacial deformation and compression of water-saturated till beneath slow-moving ice
